regions.merged_text: "False humility trouble & the sadness we feel at sight of our sins are among the most subtle of the devil's snares," Humility & sorrow which comes from God, consoles and pacifies the soul. St. Teresa "One of the best means to continue in the prac- tice of those good purposes we make in prayer is that we recolect the reason which had in- fluenced us to form them; because that which ocasioned the 1st thought will afterwards help us to conserve & practice it." St. Austin "O Lord, if Thou art pleased to bestow thy gifts upon me be thou the guardian thereof thyself, for I have a diffidence in myself and I am a great robber who may prove bankrupt to Thee." St. Francis "God chose a life of suffering. - The Way the Truth & the Life."
